summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (3.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury). ¥3,500 million upper limit. Execution 14 July 2026 – 30 September 2026. Method: ToSTNeT-3 and/or commissioned market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Acquired shares may be used for warrant exercise or cancelled.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 13 July 2026, the board of Curves Holdings resolved to acquire up to 3,000,000 treasury shares (3.3% of shares outstanding excluding existing treasury holdings) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥3,500 million. The acquisition window runs from 14 July 2026 to 30 September 2026. Execution will be conducted via ToSTNeT-3 (self-tender off-exchange) and/or commissioned market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company intends to apply a portion of acquired shares toward future warrant exercise and may cancel the remainder. The buyback aligns with the company's capital-efficiency objectives and 2030–2035 medium-term vision centred on multi-brand growth strategy.
